title: CSV/TSV Table Preview, LSP Diagnostics & Problems Pane, Deleted File Diffs, Auto-Updates & Security Hardening
summary: Introduces interactive CSV and TSV table previews with sticky headers and delimiter detection, LSP diagnostics with an inspector Problems pane and diff view indicators, language server management controls, deleted git file diffing and tree indicators, seamless background auto-updates with in-place process re-execution, strict Content-Security-Policy headers and ReDoS protections, cross-platform process metrics with micro-benchmarking, and clean copy actions excluding line numbers.

categories.name: CSV & TSV Interactive Table Preview
items: Interactive table preview overlay for CSV and TSV files with auto-detected delimiters, sticky column headers, and line number gutters
Configurable table.preview.open setting to default structured tabular views for data files
Quick toggle actions in status bar, command palette, and keyboard shortcuts with byte and row capping for memory safety

categories.name: LSP Diagnostics, Problems Pane & Server Management
items: Dedicated Problems inspector pane to view, filter, search, and navigate workspace language server diagnostics
LSP diagnostic hovers, jump-to-definition, and gutter indicators integrated into unified and split diff views
Language server management status bar popup and command palette actions to list, start, stop, and inspect running language servers
Background language server installation with polling and auto-start upon completion
Document synchronization hooks and diagnostic caching in the lightweight LSP client

categories.name: Deleted Git File Tracking & Diff Viewer Integration
items: First-class representation of deleted git files in the file explorer with virtual directory retention and strikethrough styling
Dedicated deleted file tabs defaulting to diff view with state preservation across reloads and workspace reindexing
Full diff viewer support for deleted files served via API metadata endpoints
Automatic file tree synchronization when deleted files are added, removed, or restored

categories.name: Automated In-Place Updates & Startup Diagnostics
items: Automated background update engine with platform-specific process re-execution for Unix and Windows
Added -no-update CLI flag to opt out of automated background checks and restarts
Detailed startup step durations and phase logging under verbose mode for workspace resolution, listener binding, and initialization
Reachable network URL discovery advertising sorted non-loopback IPv4 addresses on startup when binding to 0.0.0.0

categories.name: Security Hardening, CSP & ReDoS Protection
items: Strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers applied across all HTTP responses to mitigate XSS and unauthorized exfiltration
Hardened /api/raw endpoint serving non-image files as application/octet-stream with attachment disposition and nosniff headers
Fixed ReDoS vulnerability in markdown link and image parsers by eliminating catastrophic backtracking on nested parentheses

categories.name: Process Metrics, Micro-Benchmarks & System Profiling
items: POSIX getrusage process metrics tracking peak RSS and CPU sampling across Linux and macOS with Darwin ps fallback
Comprehensive Go micro-benchmark suite covering symbol search, file tree scanning, and syntax highlighting
Automated benchmark scripts supporting load testing, baseline regression comparisons, and JSON/CSV data export
Documented Apple Silicon M-series benchmark profiles highlighting sub-millisecond search latencies and minimal RAM overhead

categories.name: Editor Ergonomics, Clean Copy Actions & Auto-Reveal
items: Smart copy actions intercepting selection copy to exclude line numbers and gutter artifacts from copied code
Markdown preview copy actions supporting raw markdown extraction and formatted rich text clipboard export
explorer.autoReveal setting to automatically reveal and focus active files in the tree upon tab switching or palette selection
Replaced line gutter glyphs with clear, self-ellipsizing Edit buttons and preserved selections for multi-line actions
Dynamic right inspector tab resolution defaulting to the first visible pane when opening the inspector
